title: A Blue Hour for the Inventory
author: Tamsin Vasquez
blurb: Petra Pemberton, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
